texto: Every night at 3:07 AM, the world resets. Only you remember. Here are the rules you figured out the hard way.
Rule one: only your memories come back. You write on your arm. Gone.
Rule two: you always wake up at home, at seven. You can run anywhere. It doesn't matter.
Rule three: nobody else remembers. Ever. You tell your mom everything. The next morning, she has no idea.
But there's a fourth rule. And it's the one that nobody wrote down.
